failureCases.claim: 准备后的澄清问题或其输入被修改时，宿主调用必须被拒绝

failureCases.assertion: stale Clarify artifact digest must block Design

failureCases.claim: test-cases.md 变化后，旧 Plan proof 必须失效
failureCases.assertion: test-cases mutation must stale the Plan gate

failureCases.claim: 实现 agent 越出授权 write scope 时，写入必须被拒绝

failureCases.assertion: independent review alone must not satisfy a read-only stage gate

successCases.claim: 具备 fresh result、独立 review、receipt 与 proof 的完整 change 可以归档并离线复验
